rationale: Mechanism: volatility regime persistence should affect returns at both intermediate horizons
Both horizons show positive IC in exploratory evidence
H-10 and H-20 difference is small (0.010) — not large enough to justify excluding one
Testing both provides replication evidence within the confirmation
Pre-registered hypothesis family reduces multiple testing penalty vs. ad-hoc addition
Phase 19-C already registered H-10 as primary, H-20 as secondary

multiple_comparison_correction.family_definition: H-10 primary + H-20 secondary = 2 tests in family
multiple_comparison_correction.correction_applied: Sequential Holm-Bonferroni on the two horizon tests
multiple_comparison_correction.note: Both horizons pre-registered in Phase 19-C; not ad-hoc additions

confirmation_requirements: H-10 must show positive incremental IC (primary endpoint)
H-20 must show positive incremental IC (secondary endpoint)
Sign consistency must be > 50% at both horizons
